subject: Evidence onboarding & log-sampling plan for Vanguard Labs SIG
messages:
From: Jared Lee <jared.lee@vanguardlabs.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Patel <ava.patel@vanguardlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vanguard SIG kickoff & first pass questionnaire

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on taking our SIG request. We're preparing an internal team for a short intake call to align scope, sampling windows, and owners. High level asks from our side:

- Confirm who on Redwood will own telemetry/log samples and an SFTP/Drive handoff pattern
- Walkthrough of any encryption/retention controls we should validate during review
- A rough timeline for evidence delivery (we're aiming to close the SIG in ~3 weeks)

Ava and I are broadly available Wed/Thu mornings PT. Could you propose 2 slots, and attach the latest question bank you want us to pre-fill?

Thanks — Jared

--
Jared Lee
Senior Security Engineer
Vanguard Labs
jared.lee@vanguardlabs.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jared Lee <jared.lee@vanguardlabs.com>
Cc: Ava Patel <ava.patel@vanguardlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vanguard SIG kickoff & first pass questionnaire

Hi Jared/Ava —

Appreciate the context. Proposed slots: Wed 2027-03-10 09:00-09:30 PT or Thu 2027-03-11 10:30-11:00 PT. If neither works we can do an hour later in the afternoon.

Quick answers up front:
- Owners: I'll be primary for controls/CAIQ mapping; Marissa Cole (cc'ed) will own evidence orchestration and artifact handoff; Markus Klein can join for telemetry / KMS questions if needed.
- Handoff: We prefer a temporary shared Drive folder (see link below) for initial uploads; for large log transfers we can provide a presigned S3 URL or SFTP depending on your ops comfort.
- Encryption/retention: Redwood stores telemetry at-rest with AES-256; retention policies differ by tenant class — we'll confirm retention windows during call.

Attached: Vanguard_SIG_QuestionBank_v1.xlsx (please fill the shaded Owner column where applicable) and a short telemetry playbook (redwood-overview-telemetry-playbook.pdf).

Agenda for the call (15-30m):
1) Confirm scope & major in-scope services
2) Owner assignments for each question block
3) Sample log windows & transfer method preference
4) Timeline & target evidence drop dates

I'll hold Thu 10:30 PT as tentative and will send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
--
Attachment: Vanguard_SIG_QuestionBank_v1.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)
Attachment: redwood-overview-telemetry-playbook.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: Ava Patel <ava.patel@vanguardlabs.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jared Lee <jared.lee@vanguardlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vanguard SIG kickoff & first pass questionnaire

Thanks Grace — the Thu 10:30 PT slot works for both of us. Invite please.

Two quick clarifications before the call so we can prep:
- For log sampling: we need application access logs and inference-serving telemetry for a 72-hour window. Is a single continuous 72-hour window okay, or do you recommend split windows to capture peak/off-peak?
- For the owner column: is there a preferred format (email vs full name)? We'll fill with email addresses for faster handoffs.

Also: we saw items in the CAIQ about key rotation. Could Markus briefly outline expected artifacts to show rotation cadence and proof of KMS integration (e.g., key policy snapshots or KMS audit logs)?

Ava

--
Ava Patel
Staff Security Analyst
Vanguard Labs
ava.patel@vanguardlabs.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Patel <ava.patel@vanguardlabs.com>, Jared Lee <jared.lee@vanguardlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vanguard SIG kickoff & first pass questionnaire — call notes & next steps

Thanks for the call today — summary and action items below. I recorded the main decisions so we have a clear evidence runway.

Meeting notes (2027-03-11 10:30 PT):
- Attendees: Grace O'Connor (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Markus Klein (Redwood), Jared Lee (Vanguard), Ava Patel (Vanguard)
- Scope: SIG CAIQ + supplemental SOC-2 telemetry review for inference routing and tokenization pipeline. Vanguard requested a 72-hour contiguous log window covering weekday peak traffic.
- Log transfer method: Vanguard will upload logs to the shared Drive folder for initial review; for the 72-hour archive (multiple GB) Vanguard prefers presigned S3 transfer and will share an upload link by Mon 2027-03-14.
- KMS/key rotation: Markus reviewed rotation cadence (90-day rotations policy for per-tenant data keys; root keys rotated annually). Action: Markus to provide a KMS policy extract and a redacted rotation audit snippet.
- Evidence owners & timeline:
  - Controls matrix and most CAIQ answers: Vanguard to populate owner column; Redwood to fill remaining items where applicable. Target: first-pass answers by 2027-03-15.
  - Log sample upload (presigned S3): expected by 2027-03-18.
  - Final evidence package: target 2027-03-25 (to align with Vanguard's three-week goal).

Action items:
1) Jared/Ava — upload completed Owner column in Vanguard_SIG_QuestionBank_v1.xlsx by 2027-03-15 (FILE: Vanguard_SIG_QuestionBank_v1.xlsx).
2) Vanguard — create presigned S3 upload and share link in thread by 2027-03-14.
3) Markus Klein — attach KMS policy extract and redacted rotation logs to thread by 2027-03-14.
4) Marissa Cole — produce initial evidence index (catalog of expected artifacts) and seed Drive folder by 2027-03-12.
5) Grace O'Connor — run a short dry-run of log ingestion on a 2-hour sample when upload is available and share findings.

Attachments added to Drive during call: redwood-overview-telemetry-playbook.pdf (explains KV cache/telemetry fields) — Marissa will add a quick README describing expected file naming conventions (service_log_YYYYMMDD.tar.gz).

Next meeting: optional status check Thu 2027-03-18 09:00 PT if artifacts are delayed.

If anything above is incorrect or missing, flag here and I'll update.

Best,
Grace
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

--
